landing.eyebrow: For UK side-hustlers and small online shops
landing.promise: Find what's about to sell, launch a shop in a weekend, and keep books your accountant will accept.

points.rising: Spot products whose demand is rising, 6–10 weeks before Black Friday, Christmas and other retail moments.
points.local: Sell from UK-stock suppliers that deliver in 2–7 days. No stock to hold.
points.books: Every sale, spend and receipt in one audit-ready ledger.

landing.waitlistBody: We're opening to a small group of UK sellers first. Leave your email and we'll be in touch.
landing.checkEmail: Check your inbox and confirm your email to secure your place.
landing.privacy: We only use your email for launch and early-access updates. No tracking cookies.

waitlist.confirmed: You're on the list. We'll email you when we open.
waitlist.unsubscribed: You've been unsubscribed. We won't email you again.
waitlist.invalid: This link is invalid or has already been used.

auth.title: Sign in to momentsales.ai
auth.subtitle: We'll email you a sign-in link. No password needed.
auth.sent: Check your inbox for a sign-in link. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
auth.googleError: Google sign-in didn't work. Try again or use an email link.
auth.invalidLink: This sign-in link is invalid, used or expired.

onboarding.title: Create your workspace
onboarding.subtitle: A workspace is your shop: its listings, sales and books.
onboarding.name: Shop name
onboarding.countryHelp: momentsales.ai is UK-only at launch. More countries are coming later.

home.title: Home
home.body: Your sales, open orders, research runs and launch checklist will appear here.

research.title: Research
research.body: Run seasonal demand research for the UK and get a Top 10 product report.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: Your Top 10 reports with sources, prices, suppliers and profit forecasts.

listings.title: Listings
listings.body: Turn report products into listings, edit them and publish to your store.

store.title: Store
store.body: Your storefront theme, domain, policies and preview.

sales.title: Sales & Orders
sales.body: Orders, the fulfilment queue, tracking, returns and refunds.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.body: Spends, touches, receipts, sales and P&L, exportable as an audit pack.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.body: Stripe, suppliers and data providers, with their health status.

settings.title: Settings
settings.teamHelp: Every change here is logged in your audit trail.
settings.twoFactorOff: Add an authenticator app for extra protection. Owners will need it before billing goes live.
settings.scanHelp: Add this key to your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code.
settings.noTeamAccess: Only Owners and Admins can see the team.

command.title: Command bar
command.notAllowed: Your role can't use this command.
command.run: Press Enter to open the form

invite.signInFirst: Sign in with the email the invitation was sent to, then open the link again.
invite.error: This invitation is invalid, expired, or for a different email.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.mockMode: Demo mode: emails and Google sign-in are simulated.

money.readOnly: Your role can view this but not change it.
money.productKeyHelp: A short name for the product, like hoodie-black. Used for per-product profit.
money.baseAmountHelp: The GBP amount on your bank or card statement. We never guess exchange rates.

home.title: Home
home.salesChart: Net sales by day this month
home.noSales: No sales yet this month. Connect Stripe or record a sale to see them here.
home.viewerNote: Sales and ledger figures are visible to Owners, Admins and Accountants.

sales.title: Sales & Orders
sales.testCheckoutHelp: Opens a real Stripe Checkout in test mode for an item you describe, so you can see a sale flow through to the ledger. Use test card 4242 4242 4242 4242.
sales.stripeNotReady: Connect Stripe first (Integrations), then you can take test payments.
sales.recordSaleHelp: For sales outside Stripe, like a market stall or another marketplace.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.uploadHelp: PDF, JPG, PNG or HEIC, up to 10 MB. We read it to fill in the details; you check them before anything is saved.
ledger.ocrFailed: We couldn't read this receipt automatically. Enter the details yourself.
ledger.ocrDone: Check the details we read from the receipt, then save.
ledger.ocrSkipped: We stored this receipt but can't read this file type automatically here. Enter the details yourself.
ledger.linkToSpend: Or attach to an existing spend
ledger.exportHelp: CSV ledger, spends, touches and orders, a PDF summary, your receipts as a ZIP, and an audit-log extract with its hash chain checked.
ledger.importHelp: Upload a CSV, such as an ad platform's spend export, then match its columns.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.stripeHelp: Get paid directly into your own Stripe account. Shoppers pay you; momentsales.ai never holds your money.
integrations.ownerOnly: Only the Owner can connect or change Stripe.
integrations.testMode: Test mode: no real money moves.

mockStripe.onboardBody: This page stands in for Stripe's hosted onboarding while PROVIDER_MODE=mock.
mockStripe.checkoutBody: This page stands in for Stripe Checkout while PROVIDER_MODE=mock. No card is needed.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.metaDescription: Plans for UK side-hustlers and small online shops. 14-day free trial on Growth features.
pricing.intro: Start with a 14-day free trial on Growth features ({runs} research runs and {listings} live listings). A card is needed to start; cancel any time before the trial ends and you won't be charged.
pricing.runsAnnual: +{count} extra runs a month on annual plans
pricing.seats: {count, plural, one {# team seat} other {# team seats}}

export.csv_pdf_receipts: Audit pack: CSV, PDF summary and receipts ZIP

pricing.report: Just one report? A single research report is {price}, no subscription needed. Without a plan, a {percent}% fee applies to your sales.
pricing.packs: Need more research? Run packs: {runs} extra runs for {price}, kept while you're subscribed.
pricing.unavailable: Prices aren't available right now. Please try again shortly.

billing.title: Billing
billing.cancelScheduled: Your subscription ends on {date}. You keep full access until then.
billing.extraRuns: Extra runs: {pack} from packs, {single} single reports
billing.choosePlanHelp: Start your 14-day free trial on Growth features ({runs} research runs and {listings} live listings). You choose the plan you'll pay for after the trial.
billing.afterTrial: Your free trial has been used, so this starts a paid subscription.
billing.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can choose a plan.
billing.waitingForOwner: Waiting for the workspace owner to choose a plan.
billing.manageHelp: Change plan, update your card or tax details, and download invoices in the Stripe Customer Portal. Upgrades apply now; downgrades apply at the end of the period.
billing.pauseHelp: Pause for 1 to 3 months: no charges, research off, your data and store settings kept.

survey.title: Before you go
survey.question: Why are you cancelling?
survey.details: Anything you'd like to tell us? (optional)
survey.offerPause: You could pause for a month instead: no charges, your data kept.
survey.offerDiscount: We'd like to offer your next month free instead.
survey.confirmCancel: Cancel at the end of the period
survey.cancelled: Your subscription will end at the end of this billing period.
survey.pausedDone: Your subscription is paused for a month.

billing.checkoutDone: Thanks! We're confirming your subscription with Stripe…
billing.purchaseDone: Thanks! Your purchase will appear in a moment.
billing.checkoutCancelled: Checkout was cancelled. Nothing was charged.
billing.devToolsHelp: Research runs arrive in Phase 2. This spends one metered run, as a real run will.
billing.runUsed: Run used (from {pool, select, plan {your plan} pack {a run pack} other {a single report}}).

banner.trial: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left in your free trial.
banner.past_due: We couldn't take your last payment. Your workspace is read-only until it's paid; your storefront keeps selling.
banner.suspended: Your workspace is suspended because a payment is overdue. Your data is kept.
banner.paused: Your subscription is paused. Research and changes are off until you resume.
banner.canceled: Your subscription has ended. Your data is still here to view and export.

gate.title: Choose a plan to get started
gate.body: Start a free trial to use research, the ledger and your store.
gate.waiting: The workspace owner needs to choose a plan before you can use the app.
